IFC Creating markets and investment opportunities Ethiopia 2025-2029

description.narrative: De två pelarna, ’Generering av investeringar i strategiska sektorer’ och ’Generering av investeringar i läkemedelstillverkning’, syftar tillsammans till att generera investeringar på 140 miljoner USD i strategiska sektorer såsom logistik, telekom, energi, särskilda ekonomiska zoner (SEZ), läkemedel, grossist-/detaljhandel och jordbruksnäring.

The two pillars, "Investment generation in Strategic sectors" and "Generating investments in pharmaceuticals manufactuing" together aim to generate USD 140 million in investments in strategic sectors such as logistics, telecoms, energy, Special Economic Zones (SEZs), pharmaceuticals, wholesale/retail trade, and agribusiness.

The two pillars, "Investment generation in Strategic sectors" and "Generating investments in pharmaceuticals manufacturing" together aim to generate USD 140 million in investments in strategic sectors such as logistics, telecoms, energy, Special Economic Zones (SEZs), pharmaceuticals, wholesale/retail trade, and agribusiness.
Component 1: Investment Generation in Strategic Sectors
Removing policy and regulatory constraints to attract investments in logistics, telecom, energy, SEZs, and trading sectors.
Key Outcomes
The Ethiopia Investment Generation in Strategic Sectors (Eth IG) component aims to enable and facilitate investments of 100 MUSD by supporting reforms that address legal, regulatory, and institutional barriers, and by promoting and facilitating investments in the trading (wholesale, retail, import, and export), logistics, energy, and telecom sectors, and in SEZs.
The project expects to achieve the following outcomes by project completion: 1) Enactment of 4 laws, regulations, and directives to enhance sector specific investment environment. 2) Investment commitment of 5 firms by the end of the project.
Component 2: Generating Investments in Pharmaceuticals Manufacturing
The Ethiopia Generating Investment in Pharmaceutical Manufacturing component aims to enable and facilitate investments of 40 MUSD by enhancing procurement strategies, ensuring market access, and streamlining import/export processes to attract investments in the pharmaceutical sector.
Key outcomes
1) Enactment of at least 2 regulations or directives that support effective roll out of the pharmaceutical procurement instruments and customs duty application. 2) Streamlined export and import processes of key inputs and finished pharmaceutical products, through implementation of key regulations/procedures and directives. 3) Five private sector investment commitments in the pharmaceutical manufacturing sector registered. The investment generation is to be realized 2 years post-completion of the project.
Component 3: Transforming the Agribusiness Sector
This pillar aims to unlock value chains in the agribusiness sector by implementing regulatory reforms. The goal is to promote competition and increase private sector participation in the seed, fertilizer, and agrochemicals market by implementing regulatory reforms to unlock investment in the agribusiness value chain, improving access to quality inputs, and promoting private sector engagement.
The challenges in the sector require regulatory reform to unlock investment in agribusiness value chains
Improve Access to Quality and Sustainable Supply of Inputs:Implement policies that ensure the availability of high-quality seeds, fertilizers, and other essential inputs. This can be achieved through public-private partnerships and by encouraging private sector investment in input supply chains.
Establish Laws and Regulations to Promote Private Sector Engagement:Develop and enforce regulations that create a conducive environment for private sector participation in agricultural supply markets. This includes reducing bureaucratic hurdles, providing incentives for private investment, and ensuring fair competition by minimizing undue government intervention.
The key outcomes and the Theory of Change for this component are still being developed.
